exposure: vertical skin resection technique for nipple-sparing mastectomy
cohort: The study included 28 patients with moderate or large ptotic breasts (12 grade II, 16 grade III) who underwent nipple-sparing mastectomy using the vertical reduction pattern and immediate autologous breast reconstruction.
finding: The vertical skin resection pattern for nipple-sparing mastectomy in patients with large and/or ptotic breasts resulted in satisfactory esthetic outcomes without major complications and did not compromise oncologic safety.
